messages.subject: Re: Format titles in ggplot2
parts:
If anyone's looking for the answer:

library(ggplot2)
hgram <- qplot(rating, data = movies, binwidth = 1)
hgramt <- hgram + labs(title = "This is a histogram")
hgramt + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, angle = 180))

I guess you just replace "opts" with "title" and "theme_text" with "element_text"

I'll admit that the warning message gives a convoluted version of my instructions, but I didn't suspect that it would be that simple. 

On Wednesday, September 19, 2012 2:28:16 PM UTC-5, Gene Leynes wrote:
Why are the titles so small in ggplot2?  

I did figure out a way around the small titles, but now I can't find any documentation on how to format titles. The existing method generates warnings.

I find this example when I search for help on http://had.co.nz/ggplot2

library(ggplot2)
hgram <- qplot(rating, data = movies, binwidth = 1)
hgramt <- hgram + opts(title = "This is a histogram")
hgramt + opts(plot.title = theme_text(size = 20, 
  angle = 180))

But this example generates warnings.

The help for theme_text redirects to theme_blank, which appears to be little more than a stub.  It does mention element_text, which has no description or examples.
